The bounded grounded-editor policy fix was exercised live and the heading action passed policy without approval. Exact readback then observed '£ Release' instead of '# Release 1.0'. The sender had issued all 13 requested characters and attempted one correction, after which the unverified-draft guard rejected further mutation. No Save action ran.

The bounded Windows semantic Alt-code transport fix was exercised live for the same '# Release 1.0' action, but the guest still visibly rendered '£ Release 1.0'. Exact readback failed, one bounded correction shortened the observed text to eight characters, and the unverified-draft guard rejected further mutation. No Save action ran.

The new route receipt identified windows-rfb-print-v2 with the en-gb Windows profile but covered only HTTP print requests. The short exact heading used the paced websocket HID path and emitted all 13 characters. Native-pixel reanalysis confirms the retained post-action frame shows '# Release 1.0'; the earlier pound-sign classification was a downscaled-glyph misread. Exact post-input verification still failed and was interrupted at the campaign deadline after 90.937 seconds. No Save action ran.

The short exact heading used the guarded HTTP printer and retained windows_semantic_alt_code for the hash, proving both v4 remediations were exercised. Native-pixel reanalysis confirms the guest rendered '# Release 1.0' exactly, while primary OCR on the 1280-wide full frame read '# Release 1.4'. Exact readback stopped the action in 22.333 seconds; bounded recoveries did not rewrite the draft, and the unverified-draft guard blocked a later change-or-execute attempt. No Save action ran.

The maximized-editor native readback remediation was exercised live. The exact 13-character heading hash matched on the native retry and later native reads, and the model completed 18 actions with zero recoveries or provider failures. The run still exceeded the 300-second campaign SLA before Save As: guarded action execution consumed 191.727 seconds and provider wait consumed 95.974 seconds. It failed closed, quiesced, recorded, and rebooted.
